description: Defines an enum `WizardTask` representing different steps or tasks in an initialization wizard process for the OpenMRS application, with associated display text for UI representation.

classes.name: WizardTask
classes.description: Enum representing various tasks during system initialization, each associated with a display string for user interface.

methods.name: displayText
methods.description: Returns the display text associated with the wizard task, used for showing progress or labels in the UI.
